newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lai Sun Hotels, Cosco HK plan cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Lai Sun Hotels, Cosco HK plan cooperation.

text.p: Lai Sun Hotels International Ltd and China's COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd said on Friday they were planning co-operation in future business development after the Chinese concern bought a 20 percent stake in the hotel firm.

Shipping group COSCO (HK) took up 357 million new shares in Hong Kong-based Lai Sun Hotels for HK$606.9 million on March 27 when the latter placed a total of 716 million new shares at HK$1.70 each to raise about HK$1.17 billion after expenses.
After the deal, COSCO (HK) became the hotel group's second largest shareholder with a 20 percent interest in Lai Sun Hotels' enlarged issued share capital of 1.79 billion shares.
Property developer Lai Sun Development Co Ltd now holds 963 million shares in, or 54 percent of, the hotel firm.
"The deal will certainly help the future development of Lai Sun Hotels and other companies in Lai Sun Group," Lim Por-yen, chairman of Lai Sun Group, told a news conference.

"We are seeking further cooperation opportunities in the future, in areas including hotel and property development in both Hong Kong and China," he said. "I am certain the alliance will benefit each other's business growth."
Lai Sun Group's flagship is Lai Sun Garment (International) Ltd, which controls Lai Sun Development and garment firm Crocodile Garments Ltd.

"We wish to venture with Lai Sun in business developments in Hong Kong and China in the near future," said Zhang Dachun, executive director and vice-president of COSCO (HK), which owns a number of hotels in China.
COSCO (HK) made the latest investment, funded from its internal resources, for long term investment, Zhang said.

He said he expected the group to acquire hotel management expertise through its ties with Lai Sun Hotels, even though hotel operation contributed only a small proportion of the shipping firm's business.
Lai Sun Hotels holds stakes in a number of top-grade hotels and properties, and manages more than 60 hotels in Hong Kong and overseas. It has working capital of about HK$300 million.
COSCO (HK) is a wholly-owned unit of China Ocean Shipping (Group) Co, which is one of the world's largest container transportation and shipowning companies.

It is the parent company of Hong Kong-listed container leasing and terminal operating firm COSCO Pacific Ltd. With a total asset value of about HK$4 billion, shipping concern COSCO (HK) is engaged also in insurance, financial services, travelling, hotel, terminal and property businesses.
